description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractMigration` responsible for database migration operations within the OrangeHRM project. It provides methods to get schema managers, database connections, query builders, and helpers for schema, data, language, and configuration management. It is intended as a base class for specific migration implementations.

classes.name: AbstractMigration
classes.description: An abstract class for database migrations, providing common functionality for schema management, data helpers, and utility helpers across migration subclasses.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Returns the schema manager for the current database connection.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Provides the current database connection instance.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QueryBuilder instance for building SQL queries.

methods.name: getSchemaHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the SchemaHelper instance.

methods.name: getDataGroupHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the DataGroupHelper instance.

methods.name: getLangHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the LanguageHelper instance.

methods.name: getConfigHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the ConfigHelper instance.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Abstract method to define schema changes or data insertions for the migration.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Abstract method to return the version identifier of the migration.
